name: Ringo ga Mita Yuuyake
source:
Humans are dirty living creatures.
From that day on, I couldn't help but think that way.
However, today, I have become one of them.
A person, who couldn't be trusted by any other people.
Living days by days, without the meaning of life.

-- Do you want to play together?

She suddenly appeared in front of my eyes.
A girl who doesn't even know her house or her name
She is strange, but also, the brightest person I have ever known.
My daily life starts changing, since the day she came.

[Translated from the [url=http://team-oretachi.ivory.ne.jp/rinyu/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
人类是肮脏的生物。
从那天起，我就忍不住这么想。
然而今天，我却成为了他们中的一员。
一个不值得任何人信任的人。
日复一日地活着，却没有活着的意义。

——要一起玩吗？

她突然出现在我的眼前。
一个连自己的房子和名字都不知道的女孩
她很奇怪，但也是我所认识的最聪明的人。
从她来的那天起，我的日常生活开始改变。

[翻译自[url=http://team-oretachi.ivory.ne.jp/rinyu/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
